title: Conservative realism is unstable and covertly illusionist

statements.text: Conservative realism is continually on the verge of collapsing into illusionism. Its reductive explanations identify phenomenal character with some functional property, and they are plausible because subjects with that property would judge their experiences to have a qualitative dimension. That explains quasi-phenomenal properties, and conflates phenomenality with the representation of phenomenality.

sources.quote: it is an unstable position, continually on the verge of collapsing into illusionism
There is a conflation of phenomenality with the representation of phenomenality, and thus of realism with illusionism.
